summary: An index helps SQLite find rows without reading the whole table, like the index at the back of a book.
points: CREATE INDEX name ON table (column) builds one.
EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN shows how SQLite will run a query. SCAN reads everything, and SEARCH uses an index.
Indexes speed up reads but slow writes slightly and use space.
A composite index on (a, b) helps filters on a, or on a and b together, but not on b alone.

example.explanation: The plan now says SEARCH, using the index instead of scanning every order.
